intro.text: A darkeyed woman of Hearthstone in Alethkar, wife of the town surgeon Lirin and mother of Kaladin and Tien.
Kaladin's mother, who lives with her husband Lirin and their young son Oroden in Hearthstone.
Kaladin's mother, now living in Urithiru with her husband Lirin, their youngest son Oroden and other former residents of Hearthstone.

items.text: Hesina's family lived in Tomat, where her father was a privileged businessman who could bully the citylord. After meeting Lirin, she left her family to live with him in Hearthstone, at a cost to her social standing. There she had two sons, Kaladin and Tien, two years apart.

Hesina and Lirin had hoped to tie their family to Brightlord Wistiow's through marriage. When he fell gravely ill, they took a large sum of his spheres to pay for Kaladin's studies in Kharbranth, claiming with forged papers that Wistiow had left the money to Lirin. Rumours of theft lingered in the town.

When Brightlord Roshone arrived to replace Wistiow, Kaladin found his mother cleaning the town hall and talked with her about the gossip; she admitted she had hoped he would marry Wistiow's daughter Laral. Roshone took an immediate dislike to Lirin.

Roshone demanded the spheres back and drove the family towards poverty, though townsfolk secretly left food for Hesina. She tried to keep her sons busy while Lirin met Roshone, but Kaladin slipped away and learned the spheres really had been taken, with his mother's help.
After the death of Roshone's son Rillir, the family grew poorer, and Hesina and Lirin began slowly spending the spheres, partly to put Roshone off the scent.

When Amaram, a general of the princedom and Roshone's cousin, came to Hearthstone recruiting, Roshone had Tien conscripted out of spite. Kaladin volunteered to go with his brother, promising his parents he would keep Tien safe.

Less than four months later, Tien was killed. Kaladin sent word of his death and that he would not be coming home; his parents did not reply. Years later they heard that Kaladin had died too. Roshone's guilt softened his hostility towards them.

After the Everstorm, Kaladin returned to Hearthstone and found his parents tending the wounded in Roshone's manor. Hesina fed him, caught him up on the family's news and introduced him to his young brother, Oroden. When he left, she stayed to help the town and care for Oroden.

Under singer occupation, Hesina helped Lirin check refugees for disease. On Kaladin's visits she met Syl, and she helped hide the Mink until Kaladin came. The people of Hearthstone were then flown to Urithiru aboard the Fourth Bridge.

In Urithiru, Hesina helped care for Kaladin's battle-shocked patients. When the Fused occupied the tower, she carried supplies to the Hearthstone refugees. After Kaladin killed a singer, she and Lirin were saved from execution by Venli and set to caring for the comatose Radiants.

Rlain brought Hesina stolen maps of the tower to help Kaladin, and she offered to treat Kaladin's wounds herself. She persuaded Lirin to see the good in Kaladin's resistance. Moash then tied up Hesina, Lirin and Oroden in the infirmary as bait for Kaladin and Teft.
After Teft's death, Hesina took over the triage and joined the fighting in the tower's atrium until Kaladin returned.
After Teft's funeral, Hesina spent a peaceful morning with her sons, telling Syl embarrassing stories about Kaladin's childhood, before Kaladin said goodbye and set off for Shinovar.

appearance.text: A tall, pretty darkeyed woman, taller than her husband, with full lips, a narrow face and a bold chin. She keeps her dark hair in a tail wrapped in a kerchief, wears mostly brown, and covers her safehand with a glove.

personality.text: Quick-witted, sharp-tongued and eloquent, Hesina wants her children to choose their own Callings and rarely scolds them for odd behaviour, sometimes joining in. She finds cleaning around town a good way to clear her head.
She can read and write the women's script, the only darkeyed woman in Hearthstone who can. She sometimes assists Lirin in surgery.
More religious than Lirin, Hesina believes in glyphwards and burns simple ones for her family. She thinks everything but people has a spren living inside it.
Reunited with Kaladin, she still treats him like a child, and is delighted to learn he is a Knight Radiant.
